team-check: Photorealistic, modern documentary photograph, taken this year on a current digital camera: a Tanzanian Bible translation team checking a draft together in a bright, tidy translation office in a rural town in East Africa. Four Tanzanians around a wooden table as equals: a woman translator in her 30s leading the discussion with a printed page in hand, a male translator in his 30s pointing at a line on a modern slim laptop, a younger woman community reviewer taking notes, and a pastor in his 50s in a pressed collared shirt listening closely. Everyone is engaged and talking, no single person presides. Smartphones and a modern laptop on the table, a water bottle, a Bible. Clean painted walls, a large window with daylight, a glimpse of green trees outside. Contemporary everyday clothing, some kitenge print. Shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera, 35mm lens, f/2.8, crisp, sharp, clean low-noise image, natural true-to-life colours, no film grain, no vintage or faded look. No readable text on screens, papers or walls, no logos. Authentic, unposed, focused, not stock-photo cheerful.
reviewer-laptop: Clean, natural documentary photograph, present day, a pastor in South Asia reviewing a draft Bible translation at a simple wooden desk by a window in a small church office, late morning. A neatly groomed man in his 50s in a plain short-sleeved shirt, reading glasses, studies a laptop screen with a printed draft and a pencil beside it, one finger following a line on the page as he compares the two, thoughtful and focused. Soft daylight from the window, a potted plant, a closed Bible. 50mm lens, f/2.0, natural light, clean low-noise image, gentle true-to-life colours. Uncluttered. No readable text on the screen, papers or books, no logos, no religious symbols in focus. Authentic and unposed.
closing: Photorealistic, modern candid documentary photograph, taken this year on a current digital camera: in a rural town in Tanzania, late-afternoon golden light outside a simple brick church. A woman in her 40s in a kitenge dress sits on a wooden bench reading aloud from an open Bible in her own language. Around her, people react naturally and differently: an older man in a flat cap looks up at her, listening and smiling slightly; a teenage boy leans over to look at her page; a young mother with a toddler on her lap listens; in the background two people talk quietly, one holding a closed Bible. Only one Bible is open. Relaxed, unposed, a real moment, not arranged. Contemporary everyday clothing. Full-frame mirrorless camera, 35mm lens, f/2.2, crisp, sharp, clean low-noise image, natural warm true-to-life colours, no film grain, no vintage look. No readable text on pages or signs, no logos. Hopeful but not stock-photo cheerful.
